description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling F# types within the Orleans code generator, including identification of union cases and records, along with type description classes for F# union cases and records.

classes.name: FSharpUtilities.FSharpUnionCaseTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents the description of an F# union case type for serialization and code generation.

classes.name: FSharpUtilities.FSharpRecordTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents the description of an F# record type for serialization and code generation.

methods.name: FSharpUtilities.IsUnionCase
methods.description: Determines if a given INamedTypeSymbol is an F# union case and outputs the associated sum type symbol.

methods.name: FSharpUtilities.IsRecord
methods.description: Determines if a given INamedTypeSymbol is an F# record type.

methods.name: FSharpUtilities.FSharpUnionCaseTypeDescription
methods.description: Constructs a type description for an F# union case.

methods.name: FSharpUtilities.FSharpRecordTypeDescription
methods.description: Constructs a type description for an F# record.
